title: Mutube data file
description: Portable Mutube library document. This is the on-disk format written to mutube.data.json and produced by Export. Keep `version` in sync with AppData['version'] in src/types.ts.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the shape changes incompatibly.

videos.description: All known videos keyed by YouTube video ID.

videoOrder.description: Display order of the home 'All videos' grid. Newest-added first by default; reorderable. Should contain exactly the keys of `videos`.

blacklist.description: Collection IDs limited to one video per session (kid mode); these also hide the player recommendations panel.

id.description: YouTube video ID; also the dedup key.

alias.description: Parent-assigned display name. Defaults to title when absent. The only field home search matches.

embeddable.description: Whether the video can play in an embedded player.

addedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the parent added it.

emoji.description: Optional kid-friendly icon for the collection card.

coverVideoId.description: Optional video whose thumbnail is the collection cover. Falls back to emoji.

videoIds.description: Ordered list of all video IDs in this collection (union of its sub-lists).

subCollections.description: Optional sub-lists (seasons/topics) shown grouped under the collection.

parentPinHash.description: Hash of the parent PIN. Absent => no PIN set.

sourceUrl.description: URL of the external JSON document used as the library database. Loaded on startup when set.
